components.name: Namespace
components.description: Scopes namespaced API objects and policy

components.name: Workload labels
components.description: Attach key/value metadata to Pods and controllers

components.name: Selector
components.description: Matches labels to identify a set of objects

components.name: Service / controller
components.description: Uses selectors to target Pods or manage replicas

components.name: NetworkPolicy
components.description: Can constrain Pod ingress/egress when supported CNI enforces it

operational_steps: Service / controller acts on selected set
failure_checkpoint: Selector mismatch or unintended namespace scope
recovery_path: Inspect labels and selectors with kubectl get ... --show-labels; correct selector and namespace targeting.
